note: Callers ask for a ROLE, never a model id. model-roster.mjs resolves each role to an id that `opencode models` lists now, so a provider moving to a new version is followed instead of breaking every call. family = a regular expression over the listed ids (the part after provider/); capture 1 = the version, capture 2 (optional) = a suffix. prefer = ordering rules applied in order: version-desc puts the highest version first, plain-first puts an id with no suffix before one with a suffix in suffixOrder (a dated id counts as -date). No provider is set: a role resolves from the one provider that lists its family; when two do, name the provider for that role (MODEL_ROSTER_PROVIDERS=role=provider,role=provider, or a "provider" key on the role here), or one provider for every role (MODEL_ROSTER_PROVIDER, or sources.provider here). Edit the families if your providers name models differently. This file is yours: setup.sh keeps an edited copy. The cache (last-known-good ids, used only when opencode can't be run) and the change log are in ~/.cache/model-roster/.
